$comment: Contract for the GenerateExport server-side command (AD-003, AD-039, AD-034 manual only). Custom API parameter Type codes: 0=Boolean, 10=String.

customApi.name: al_GenerateExport
customApi.description: Snapshots each Closed case into an al_exportrecord in the AD-039 20-column Trail Light shape and marks the batch Generated. Enforces the caller holds Edit on export.generate, is idempotent per batch and writes an immutable Audit Event.

requestParameters.name: BatchId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_exportbatch to populate.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same result.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written.

responseProperties.name: Conflict
responseProperties.description: True when an optimistic-concurrency conflict was detected.
